definitions.full: H2942. teem טְעֵם 30 noun masculine Ezra 4:21 taste, judgement, command (Biblical Hebrew טַ֫עַס (late sense)); — absolute ׳ט Dan 3:10 +, construct ׳ט 5:2 ; Ezra 6:14 , טַ֫עַס (of God, mere scribal distinction Nö LCB 1896, 305 Str § 8 c K Aramaismen 40 ) 6:14 ; 7:23 ; emphatic טַעְמָא 4:21 ; — 1 Dan 5:2 in the taste of the wine (while they were enjoying it). 2 judgement, discretion , in reply, וּט עֵטָא ׳הֲתִיב Dan 2:14 ( Prov 26:16 ); in act (person) ט ׳שִׂים על Dan 3:12 ; 6:14 ( Prov 26:16 ); in act (person) ט על׳שִׂים Dan 3:12 ; 6:14 shew proper deference to ( עַל ). 3 report (of official), with הלך Ezra 5:5 , יהב Dan 6:3 . 4 command , of God Ezra 6:14 ; 7:23 , of king 6:14 ; ט ׳שִׂיס give command, issue decree Dan 3:10 3 t., Ezra 4:19 , 21 (twice in verse) + 11 t.; ט ׳בְּעֵל commander 4:8-9 , 17 . עֵטָא noun feminine counsel ; — absolute Dan 2:14 (see טְעֵם 2 ). יצא see שֵׁיצֵא .
